standing_rules: Every easy day must land 145-155 HR, not just 'Zone 2 by Strava's wider 139-173 definition' - this has been the athlete's recurring failure mode (multiple 'easy' runs landing 166-181bpm) and directly caused the Low Aerobic Shortage status. Enforce this explicitly every week, don't assume it's fixed.
Cutback week every 4th week (weeks 4, 7, 10) - non-negotiable given this athlete's history of not respecting easy-day intensity; recovery weeks carry extra importance here.
Long run peaks at 13.0mi (week 9) - do not exceed race distance in training.

Once within 3 weeks of race day (week 10 onward), standard 'protect the long run, respect load ceiling' rules are superseded by taper logic: freshness beats fitness, default to less, do not chase missed volume.
Race week (week 12, 10-12 to 10-17): shakeout runs only (3-4mi easy, no quality work after Tuesday), full rest 1-2 days before the race, race is Saturday 10-17.
